integrity: Analytic argument establishes all-order quantifiers. Standalone executable is supplementary finite diagnostics, not a certificate of a general proof. The 2013 comparison source was not available in full.
scientific_limitations: Real Hadamard matrices only; no existence theorem; no exact norm claim beyond the displayed lower bound; no classification of other linear isometries. Earlier equivalent descriptions cannot be excluded.
title: Hadamard isometries of cube–crosspolytope interpolation balls
